description: Estimate Canadian capital gains tax on a disposition (real estate, stocks, crypto, a business, or a rental property). Applies the flat 50% inclusion rate, the principal-residence exemption, the lifetime capital gains exemption for QSBC shares, capital-loss offsets, and rental CCA recapture — then taxes the taxable gain on top of your other income at federal + provincial brackets.

annualIncome.description: Your other annual income in CAD — the gain stacks on top of this

buyingCosts.description: Land transfer tax, legal fees, and other costs of acquiring

capitalImprovements.description: Capital improvements added to the adjusted cost base

capitalLosses.description: Prior/current capital losses available to offset the gain

ccaClaimedToDate.description: Rental only: total CCA claimed to date

isPrincipalResidence.description: Real estate only: claim the principal residence exemption

isQSBC.description: Business only: qualified small business corporation shares (LCGE)

landValue.description: Rental only: land portion of the sale price (splits land vs building gain)

lcgeRemaining.description: Remaining lifetime capital gains exemption room in CAD

originalBuildingCost.description: Rental only: original building cost for CCA recapture

sellingCosts.description: Realtor commission, legal fees, and other costs of selling

yearsDesignated.description: Years designated as your principal residence

yearsOwned.description: Years the property was owned (principal-residence proration)

title: Canadian Capital Gains Tax Calculator
